verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Qodo installs as a GitHub/GitLab (and other provider) app via a setup wizard and automatically reviews every PR with inline findings, severity ranking, and fix/dismiss actions in the PR itself (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-2, qodo-docs-3, qodo-docs-18). No independent hands-on account explicitly confirms the 'within minutes' setup speed or native inline comment rendering on GitHub/GitLab specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of install speed and inline-comment UX, and explicit GitHub/GitLab app-store listing evidence.
